mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.dept_id, d.dept_name, u.status, u.phonenumber AS phone FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.role_key = 'DEPT_ADMIN' LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE u.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY u.dept_id, u.user_id

SELECT 'REGISTER' AS todo_type, ra.id AS biz_id, CONCAT(IFNULL(ra.real_name, '未填写'), ' 的报名待审核') AS title, CONCAT('提交于 ', DATE_FORMAT(ra.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i')) AS detail, ra.dept_id, d.dept_name, ra.user_id AS target_id, ra.real_name AS target_name, ra.create_time AS happen_time FROM register_application ra LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = ra.dept_id WHERE ra.status = 'WAIT_AUDIT' ORDER BY ra.create_time

SELECT 'REVIEW' AS todo_type, a.id AS biz_id, a.task_id, CONCAT(t.task_name, ' · ', IFNULL(u.nick_name, '未知'), ' 已提交待批阅') AS title, CONCAT('第 ', s.version, ' 次提交 · ', DATE_FORMAT(s.submit_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i')) AS detail, u.dept_id, d.dept_name, a.user_id AS target_id, u.nick_name AS target_name, t.deadline, s.submit_time AS happen_time FROM task_assignment a INNER JOIN learning_task t ON t.id = a.task_id AND t.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN task_submission s ON s.assignment_id = a.id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = a.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE s.review_status = 'PENDING' AND s.version = (SELECT MAX(s2.version) FROM task_submission s2 WHERE s2.assignment_id = a.id) ORDER BY s.submit_time

SELECT 'OVERDUE_TASK' AS todo_type, a.id AS biz_id, a.task_id, CONCAT(t.task_name, ' · ', IFNULL(u.nick_name, '未知'), ' 逾期未交') AS title, CONCAT('截止 ', DATE_FORMAT(t.deadline, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i')) AS detail, u.dept_id, d.dept_name, a.user_id AS target_id, u.nick_name AS target_name, t.deadline, TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, t.deadline, NOW()) AS overdue_hours, t.deadline AS happen_time FROM task_assignment a INNER JOIN learning_task t ON t.id = a.task_id AND t.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = a.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE a.status = 'OVERDUE' ORDER BY t.deadline

SELECT 'STALLED_STUDY' AS todo_type, sr.id AS biz_id, CONCAT(IFNULL(u.nick_name, '未知'), ' · ', IFNULL(c.course_name, '未知课程'), ' 学习停滞') AS title, CONCAT('最近学习 ', IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(sr.last_study_time, '%Y-%m-%d'), '从未开始'), ' · 已 ', DATEDIFF(NOW(), IFNULL(sr.last_study_time, sr.create_time)), ' 天无进展') AS detail, u.dept_id, d.dept_name, sr.user_id AS target_id, u.nick_name AS target_name, DATEDIFF(NOW(), IFNULL(sr.last_study_time, sr.create_time)) AS idle_days, sr.last_study_time AS happen_time FROM study_record sr INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = sr.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id = sr.course_id WHERE sr.status IN ('NOT_STARTED', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND DATEDIFF(NOW(), IFNULL(sr.last_study_time, sr.create_time)) >= #{idleDays} ORDER BY idle_days DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice n INNER JOIN notice_target nt ON nt.notice_id = n.id WHERE n.biz_type = 'URGE' AND nt.user_id = #{userId} AND n.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND DATE(n.publish_time) = CURDATE()
